title: Cardinal Rental Reimbursement Customer-Arranged Rentals: Receipt Submission Tool Card
content:
**Rule.** Under Cardinal Rental Reimbursement, a rental that the customer arranged at an agency outside the partner network is reimbursed when the customer submits its receipts personally. The reimbursement is made for the claim's most recent authorization of a customer-arranged rental. Its start date, recorded daily rate, authorized days and closing end date are read from the rental ledger. Receipts are reimbursed only when submitted no later than the option's receipt submission days, counted in calendar days after the rental ended.

## When the reimbursement is made

A reimbursement for a rental the customer arranged is not made until every agency payment on the claim that billed a higher daily rate than its authorization recorded carries an agency credit entry against it.

Put another way: while any agency payment on the claim that billed a daily rate above the rate its authorization recorded stands without an agency credit entry against it on the rental ledger, no reimbursement for a customer-arranged rental is made.

## What a submission records

Each submission records one reimbursement to the customer on the claim's rental ledger. The entry shows the receipt reference, the number of rental days on the receipts and the amount reimbursed. The amount is added to the rental benefit paid on the option, and the customer is told the reimbursement is issued.

## Tool and who runs it

The tool is `submit_own_rental_receipts_258c32b3`. It belongs to the customer. The representative unlocks it and hands it over. The customer themselves runs it, submitting the receipts and accepting the reimbursement quoted for them.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `rental_coverage_id` | Reference number of the rental reimbursement option, as given to the customer from the rental option lookup | Identifier |
| `customer_id` | Customer reference number of the named insured, as given to the customer from the profile lookup | Identifier |
| `claim_number` | Physical damage claim number of the loss, as given to the customer from the claim lookup | Identifier |
| `authorization_number` | Authorization number of the rental the customer arranged, as given to the customer from the rental ledger lookup | Identifier |
| `receipt_reference` | Rental agreement or receipt number printed on the agency's receipt, exactly as the customer reads it out | Verbatim: copied character for character, every letter, digit and hyphen kept, no reformatting |
| `days_billed` | Number of rental days the agency's receipt bills, as printed on it | Whole number of days |
| `amount` | Reimbursement amount quoted to the customer for this submission | US dollars, 2 decimal places, positive |

## Return

On success the tool returns:
- the word "reimbursed" as the status;
- the reference number of the reimbursement entry;
- the receipt reference recorded;
- the amount reimbursed (US dollars, 2 decimal places);
- the reimbursement date (YYYY-MM-DD).
